messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

Use official R&S specifications and features documents for our signaling claims, because the CMX500 page relies on the CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 for binding specifications, hardware, order numbers, and signaling / measurement / application options [75].
Use the CMX500 specifications for numeric or guaranteed performance claims, because the specifications document states the product data conditions and that data without tolerance limits is not binding [58].
Use the CMX500 features document only for feature / option coverage, because it is a Features and Functions overview and not a specifications datasheet [35].
Use official R&S production / non-signaling tester documents for non-signaling claims, such as CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 and CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 [84].
Use official CMP200 specifications for FR2 mmWave non-signaling claims, because CMP200 with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 is documented as a 5G NR FR2 nonsignaling one-box test solution for R&D and high-volume manufacturing RF parametric testing [19].
Use official CMW100 K06 specifications for CMW100 K06 production-test claims, because the CMW100 K06 page is based on PD 5214.8348.22 Version 05.00 and states the required product-data conditions [23].
Do not use R&S battle cards alone as technical proof, because the CMX500 comparisons against Amarisoft, Anritsu, and Keysight are sales positioning rather than binding technical specifications [1][8][31].
For competitor capability or limitation claims, obtain competitor official datasheets, order data, option codes, software versions, release status, and test conditions, because the Keysight battle card lacks official UXM SKU datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions [28].
For Anritsu claims such as MT8000A FR2 frequency, bandwidth, data rate, or FR3 range, obtain Anritsu official sources, because those numbers currently require Anritsu official evidence before customer use [50].
For Amarisoft claims such as no Wi-Fi signaling, no production / ATE testers, remote-only support, or no global footprint, obtain Amarisoft official资料 or third-party evidence, because the current claims come from an R&S internal battle card and are not Amarisoft official specifications or third-party validation [25][27].
For claims about conformance, operator acceptance, PTCRB, GCF, or validated NTN, obtain actual validation reports, test case lists, accreditation or certification evidence, because the Amarisoft comparison notes missing option codes or accreditation documents and the Keysight battle card lacks validation reports, PTCRB RFT 555 versions, and test case lists [61][64].
For FR3 / RFU18 / 6G roadmap claims, obtain formal RFU18 datasheets, order numbers, release dates, supported configurations, bandwidth, software releases, and measurement conditions, because current RFU18 and FR3 evidence is battle-card or PR-level and not formal specifications [46][48].
For TCO, “only,” “first,” “industry-leading,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” claims, obtain formal evidence or avoid the wording, because those terms are identified as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications [2][9][64][68].
For a fair comparison, cite our product’s official documents and the competitor’s official documents side by side, because R&S battle-card competitor descriptions require official competitor or third-party verification before use in customer documents [2][9][28].

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft]]、[[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 同屬 2026-02-26 R&S battle card 類型來源；三者都應視為競品銷售定位，而不是正式規格來源。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式規格仍需以 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]（Version 11.00，August 2025）與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]（Version 32，CSW 9.20.0 and higher）追溯。
- 本來源提到 [[R&S CMW500]] covers all legacy + EN-DC；[[R&S CMW500]] 的正式資料需追溯 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]。
- 本來源新增 [[Keysight]] 在 wireless device testing battle card 語境中的公司與 UXM portfolio 描述；既有 [[Keysight]] 頁主要來自高頻高速 PCB 測試圖像來源，兩者資料層次不同。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 對 Keysight 的主要主張
| 主題 | 來源對 Keysight 的說法 | 限制 |
|---|---|---|
| Portfolio | UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms E7515B/W/P/E/R、ProbSim、Nemo、RaySim、Atlas、C-V2X、cybersecurity tools | 未提供 Keysight 官方 datasheet 或版本 |
| Architecture | Multi-Box UXM approach；不同 UXM 有不同 NR bandwidth、RF ports、Rel-17 support、WLAN capability、IP throughput、FR2 readiness | 未列各 SKU 的完整規格條件 |
| Software model | Atlas + Channel Studio + RaySim + Nemo + WLAN tools + UXM-specific features；no unified automation environment | 這是 R&S battle card 觀點，需 Keysight 官方資料驗證 |
| Support model | tiered KeysightCare model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support；optional warranty / calibration assurance plan | 未提供 KeysightCare 文件版次或服務條款 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi signaling only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | 未提供 Keysight WLAN option / configuration 文件 |
| RedCap | E7515R is dedicated RedCap / IoT model | 未提供 E7515R 官方規格或 order data |
| FR3 / 6G | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | future hardware / software 未標示日期、型號或 release status |

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Keysight 相關
- [[Keysight]] — 本 battle card 的競品公司。
- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。
- [[Keysight E7515B]] — 來源稱 standard / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515R]] — 來源稱 RedCap / IoT-only SKU。
- [[ProbSim]] — channel emulator；來源在 integrated vs external fading landmine 中列名。
- [[RaySim]] — digital twin / ray tracing engine；來源說 advanced fading、digital twin、FR3 / 6G scenarios 可能需要 RaySim。
- [[Channel Studio]] — channel modeling / fading 相關 external tool。
- [[Nemo]] — field test tools；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[Atlas]] — AI-powered device test / test management；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[KeysightCare]] — 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered KeysightCare：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，以及 optional warranty / calibration assurance plan。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。
- [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 是 Anritsu product brochure，可用於描述 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 與 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，但不可用來驗證 R&S 對 CMX500 的優勢主張。
- Source 中的 only platform、industry-leading、widest frequency range、lower TCO 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth 與 data rate 相關矛盾與限制已集中標註於 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。

- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。
- 來源稱 all existing [[R&S CMX500]] platforms can be enhanced with new [[RFU18]] board to extend frequency coverage and capabilities without replacing the entire system。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] engineered for data rates up to **20 Gbps**，supporting wide dynamic range、[[4096QAM]] 與 up to **16 device antenna ports**。
- 來源仍未提供 [[RFU18]] order number、formal specs 文件編號、bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software release 或 measurement conditions。

Anritsu MT8000A › Battle card 中的定位
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被列為 Anritsu mobile test portfolio 的 5G NR FR1 / FR2 / FR3 平台，但 source 認為其架構 fragmented：

- 需要 separate RF boards for FR1 / FR2 / FR3。

- FR2 使用 external mmWave converters。

CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S CMP200]] **Radio Communication Tester** 的 specifications data sheet，文件代碼 **PD 5216.4391.22**，文件版本 **Version 08.00**，發布時間 **August 2024**，文件標題為 **CMP200 Radio Communication Tester Specifications Data Sheet**。

[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）組成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為 R&D 與 manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；RRH 則負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。

文件同時涵蓋 [[R&S CM-Z310A]] UWB head、[[R&S CM-Z30A]] RRH connection cable、[[R&S CM-Z33A]] UWB head connection cable、UWB head RF cable、software options、mmWave extension、UWB extension、extras 與 service options。

來源明確標示：**Data without tolerance limits is not binding**、**Subject to change**。Specifications with limits 才代表保證的 product performance；n. trc.、typ.、nom.、meas. 均不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。Uncertainties 採 coverage factor 2，依 GUM 計算。

CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800 › Remote radio head 架構
[[R&S CMP200]] 搭配 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 可在 mmWave frequency range 使用極短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。來源列出三種應用：

- pure radiated mmWave setup：測試 fully assembled smart devices。
- mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup：測試具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits。
- mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup：測試具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits。

Use official R&S specifications and features documents for our signaling claims, because the CMX500 page relies on the CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 for binding specifications, hardware, order numbers, and signaling / measurement / application options [75].
Use the CMX500 specifications for numeric or guaranteed performance claims, because the specifications document states the product data conditions and that data without tolerance limits is not binding [58].
Use the CMX500 features document only for feature / option coverage, because it is a Features and Functions overview and not a specifications datasheet [35].
Use official R&S production / non-signaling tester documents for non-signaling claims, such as CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 and CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 [84].
Use official CMP200 specifications for FR2 mmWave non-signaling claims, because CMP200 with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 is documented as a 5G NR FR2 nonsignaling one-box test solution for R&D and high-volume manufacturing RF parametric testing [19].
Use official CMW100 K06 specifications for CMW100 K06 production-test claims, because the CMW100 K06 page is based on PD 5214.8348.22 Version 05.00 and states the required product-data conditions [23].
Do not use R&S battle cards alone as technical proof, because the CMX500 comparisons against Amarisoft, Anritsu, and Keysight are sales positioning rather than binding technical specifications [1][8][31].
For competitor capability or limitation claims, obtain competitor official datasheets, order data, option codes, software versions, release status, and test conditions, because the Keysight battle card lacks official UXM SKU datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions [28].
For Anritsu claims such as MT8000A FR2 frequency, bandwidth, data rate, or FR3 range, obtain Anritsu official sources, because those numbers currently require Anritsu official evidence before customer use [50].
For Amarisoft claims such as no Wi-Fi signaling, no production / ATE testers, remote-only support, or no global footprint, obtain Amarisoft official资料 or third-party evidence, because the current claims come from an R&S internal battle card and are not Amarisoft official specifications or third-party validation [25][27].
For claims about conformance, operator acceptance, PTCRB, GCF, or validated NTN, obtain actual validation reports, test case lists, accreditation or certification evidence, because the Amarisoft comparison notes missing option codes or accreditation documents and the Keysight battle card lacks validation reports, PTCRB RFT 555 versions, and test case lists [61][64].
For FR3 / RFU18 / 6G roadmap claims, obtain formal RFU18 datasheets, order numbers, release dates, supported configurations, bandwidth, software releases, and measurement conditions, because current RFU18 and FR3 evidence is battle-card or PR-level and not formal specifications [46][48].
For TCO, “only,” “first,” “industry-leading,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” claims, obtain formal evidence or avoid the wording, because those terms are identified as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications [2][9][64][68].
For a fair comparison, cite our product’s official documents and the competitor’s official documents side by side, because R&S battle-card competitor descriptions require official competitor or third-party verification before use in customer documents [2][9][28].

- “no global footprint”、“remote-only support”、“no Wi-Fi signaling”、“no production/ATE testers” 等競品限制需另以 amarisoft 官方資料或第三方來源確認。

amarisoft › 來源中的競品定位
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 將 [[amarisoft]] 定位為 cost-efficient and flexible for functional testing，但列出以下限制：

- 缺少 calibrated RF。
- 缺少 conformance / operator acceptance assurance。
- 缺少 validated NTN。
- 缺少 global support、calibration labs、field service、SLAs。
- 缺少 instrument-class long warranty。
- FR2 依賴 external hardware / external RRH，來源以 “calibration?” 標示疑問。
- 缺少 2G/3G stack。
- 缺少 Wi-Fi signaling。
- 缺少 production / ATE testers 與 non-signaling factory-line path。

以上是 R&S sales battle card 的競品論述；不是 [[amarisoft]] 官方規格，也不是第三方市場驗證。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源與 [[CMP180_Features_V11-9_en_09]]、[[CMP200_Features_V8-14-22_en_09]] 同屬 Rohde & Schwarz radio communication tester 的 Features and Functions 文件，但 [[R&S CMX500]] 聚焦於 5G/LTE/WLAN signaling、protocol/application tests、FR1/FR2 measurements、fading/AWGN 與可擴充 OBT hardware architecture。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 的 Features and Functions 文件涵蓋 Bluetooth、WLAN、LTE、NR FR1、NB-IoT、UWB、GSM、WCDMA、CDMA2000 等 production / nonsignaling / TX/RX options；本來源未把 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 CMP180 的替代品，不應合併產品頁。
- [[R&S CMP200]] 的 Features and Functions 文件主要聚焦 NR FR2、UWB、LP-IoT 與 UWB test plans；本來源的 [[R&S CMX500]] 也有 NR FR2 measurement options，但同時涵蓋 broader signaling、application 與 hardware deployment。
- 本來源是 Features and Functions，不是 specifications datasheet；報價或規格保證仍需查 [[R&S CMX500]] specifications document / product brochure 與正式 ordering data。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張
[[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 指 R&S sales battle cards 中以 [[R&S CMX500]] / upcoming [[RFU18]] 對比競品 FR3 / 6G path 的銷售定位說法；它不是正式 RFU18 或 CMX500 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 另提供一個 PR / demonstration-level 來源，說 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 13 GHz 驗證 [[5G NR]] high-throughput performance，但該 PR 同樣不是 formal CMX500 / RFU18 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 進一步提供 PR 層級來源，明確把 new [[RFU18]] board、CMX500 coverage up to 18 GHz 與 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 連在一起；但它仍未提供 RFU18 formal datasheet、order number 或完整 test conditions。

CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100 › 重點摘要
- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD 與 TDD device testing。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 配置包含 OBT lite、OBT、OBT plus、OBT FR1 specialist、OBT FR2 specialist，主要差異在 [[R&S CMX-B200A]] accelerator unit、[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF unit、[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的數量。
- [[NR FR1]] 與 [[LTE]] 測試使用 integrated RF units；[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的 frequency range 為 **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- [[NR FR2]] 測試可搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] remote radio head；remote radio head 在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。
- 適用的 radiated chamber test environments 包含 [[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 vector signal analysis 與 ARB generator，可做 FR2 transmitters / receivers RF parametric testing；5G NR receiver tests 可在 3GPP fading propagation conditions 下使用 internal baseband fading emulation。
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘，符合指定 environmental conditions，遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

- 文件聲明：**Data without tolerance limits is not binding**；**Subject to change**。
- 版權：© 2019–2025 [[Rohde & Schwarz]]。
